rationale: The 196-bps bid-ask spread alone represents an immediate ~$0.14 entry cost per share, consuming most of any realistic intraday edge on a $7.14 stock with a $0.22 5-minute ATR. Relative volume is only 0.25x normal, meaning the float (0.07M shares) is barely turning over, creating extreme slippage risk on entry and exit. With no news catalyst, price sitting 13.7% off the day's low but still far below both 5-min VWAP ($8.13) and session VWAP ($9.35) in a choppy, directionless tape, there is no reliable structural edge in either direction that justifies absorbing the liquidity costs.
